analyst_view.overall: Two sides near the bottom on 1 point each: Pafos are 31st (3-7 goals) and Midtjylland 34th after a 6-1 defeat to Ajax, so both need a win to stay in the play-off race. Midtjylland won 2-0 at Brøndby on Monday to lead the Danish league and play the title clash at Copenhagen on Sunday, so Mike Tullberg has a strong reason to rotate; Kjell Wätjen is banned and Ousmane Diao, keeper Bakker, Castillo, Gogorza and others are on the numbers' list. Pafos lose Lelê to a ban (counted, about -19% for their goals), and have dropped injured winger Ngamaleu from their UEFA list for 20-year-old Murad Mammadov, while Gorter and Jajá are also out; none of those three is in the numbers. Domingos Quina was sent off in the league at the weekend and faces a club fine, and Sá Pinto admitted the 2-1 win over Omonia Aradippou needed luck. Referee Ishmael Barbara's low card rate is already in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals and already cut Pafos for Lelê's ban. They don't know Pafos are also without winger Ngamaleu, or that Midtjylland are likely to rest players before Sunday's title game at Copenhagen, so I go to about 2.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.4 corners, fairly even. Both sides play through wide areas and that should not change with rotation, so I stay at 10.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.4 cards, already low because referee Ishmael Barbara has shown 3.3 a game. Quina's red was in the Cypriot league and there is nothing heated between these clubs, so I stay at 3.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.9 shots. A likely rotated Midtjylland with the title clash on Sunday, and Pafos missing two attacking players (Lelê counted, Ngamaleu not), point a little lower, so I go to about 26.8.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.8 shots on target. Pafos without Lelê and Ngamaleu lose much of their cutting edge, and a changed Midtjylland side tends to create less, so I go to about 9.3.
